lead: We fit out restaurants, cafés and bars on a turnkey basis: MEP for kitchen equipment, ventilation, hard-wearing dining room finishes, bar, terrace, furniture and lighting. We work to a schedule set by your opening date, with one estimate and one accountable manager.
cards: equipment layout to the kitchen plan
about: Why a venue is not an apartment

In a restaurant, what matters most is what guests never see: extraction and supply ventilation, power for equipment, floor drains, kitchen surface requirements. A mistake in MEP shows up after opening, when it has to be fixed in a working venue.

So we build to a design in which engineering matches the equipment layout and the dining room matches the flows of guests, waiters and deliveries. The opening date goes into the contract, and the schedule is built around it.

Our restaurant projects include Yacht Restaurant (a premium restaurant with brass-mesh arches and woven pendants) and Monpark (a hall with a wine wall, courtyard terrace and pavilion). We can start from a concept or deliver your existing design.

Design costs from $30 per m² (minimum $2 500); the fit-out is priced per project, depending on ventilation, equipment and the condition of the premises. Furniture, lighting and tableware from China via Ozdoba — from $500, minimum 10 units per item, delivery 30–60 days.
